cat << 'EOF' > parse.py
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, json
t=ET.parse('mjcf.xml'); r=t.getroot()
wb=r.find('worldbody')
joints=[]
def walk(b,depth):
    for j in b.findall('joint'):
        joints.append({'name':j.get('name'),'type':j.get('type','hinge'),
                       'axis':[float(x) for x in (j.get('axis') or '0 0 1').split()],
                       'range':j.get('range')})
    for fj in b.findall('freejoint'):
        joints.append({'name':fj.get('name'),'type':'free','axis':None,'range':None})
    for cb in b.findall('body'):
        walk(cb,depth+1)
for b in wb.findall('body'):
    walk(b,0)
acts=[]
for a in r.find('actuator'):
    acts.append({'name':a.get('name'),'joint':a.get('joint'),'ctrlrange':a.get('ctrlrange')})
sites=[s.get('name') for s in wb.iter('site')]
free=[b.get('name') for b in wb.iter('body') if b.find('freejoint') is not None]
print('joints',[ (j['name'],j['type']) for j in joints])
print('acts',[a['name'] for a in acts])
print('sites',sites)
print('free',free)
EOF
python parse.py
